# B"H — Profile Trending (geelooy/api/social/helper/profile/trending/)

Trending ranking for profiles/discovery.

- `TrendingRanker.js` — ranks trending aliases/posts.
- `TrendingScore.js` — computes trending scores.
- `test/` — `TrendingRanker.test.js`, `TrendingScore.test.js`.
